{"metadata":{"description":"dsh web start ui - 启动动画 / launch-video plugin for the DSH Web GUI and desktop client: built-in and custom launch skins, a settings page, and a feedback group QR code.","id":"gh:1408905466","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-start-ui","slug":"stushansusu/dsh-web-start-ui","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","launcher","startup-animation","video"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh web start ui - 启动动画 / launch-video plugin for the DSH Web GUI and desktop client: built-in and c"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ustom launch skins, a settings page, and a feedback group QR code."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-start-ui · Startup Animation for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Startup animation for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Launch video skins · On screen before the shell paints · Click or Esc to skip · Its own settings pag"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"aunch video skins · On screen before the shell paints · Click or Esc to skip · Its own settings page"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"An extension for the DSH Web GUI and desktop client: the page opens on a **launch video** instead of"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" a cold, half-assembled shell, and the curtain lifts when the video ends. It ships two skins, accept"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"s your own uploads, and adds one first-level settings page (Settings → Startup animation). No DSH so"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"urce change, no third-party request."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Playing before the GUI paints.** The host half contributes one inline script to the served index"},{"id":"p8s2","text":".html, so the video element exists and is fetching ~30 ms into navigation. Measured on a 0.2.0-rc.2 "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"host with the shipped skin: element at 3 ms, metadata at 211 ms, playback at 622 ms, while the GUI's"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" own first paint is at 191 ms — the animation is already covering it.
- **Adopted, not restarted.** "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"The browser half takes over that same `<video>` element, so the animation keeps its buffer and its `"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"currentTime` instead of jumping back to the start.
- **Lifts when the video ends** (and not before t"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"he shell has painted, bounded by a hold cap). A skin the browser cannot decode lifts on a safety tim"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"er instead: a broken video never becomes a wall in front of the GUI.
- **Two sources of skins.** Two"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" are shipped in the package; more can be uploaded from the settings page and deleted there again. Se"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"e Launch skins.
- **Skip on demand.** Click anywhere or press Escape to lift it immediately.
- **The"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"me aware.** It follows the shell's light/dark preference, remembers it for the next boot's early bac"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"kdrop, and honours `prefers-reduced-motion`."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Half | What it does |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Host (`src/index.ts`) | Serves the launch-skin catalog and the video bytes (`src/host/routes.ts`: "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"list, select, upload, delete, and Range-capable asset GETs; mutations are loopback-only on top of th"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"e platform's own browser auth), and contributes the served index's early backdrop: a global with the"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" selected skin's URLs plus one inline script that paints the backdrop — and starts the video — befor"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"e the module graph is requested. |
| Browser (`src/client/index.ts`) | Adopts the `<video>` the host"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" started, wraps it in the curtain (the theme backdrop, the skip footnote, the outro), removes the ea"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"rly layer it is covering, and registers the settings section. |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The handoff is deliberately narrow: the early layer is `pointer-events: none`, one z-index step belo"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"w the real curtain, and it is removed the instant the curtain exists (the adopted video is moved out"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" of it first) — the outro fades to transparent, so a leftover backdrop would otherwise reappear as t"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"he GUI came back. A browser half that never loads leaves no dark window behind: the served row arms "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"its own 15 s removal timer."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Launch skins"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"A launch skin is a **video**: one directory holding a `skin.json` manifest plus the video (and an op"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tional poster frame). Video is the only medium — there is no style engine — so with no skin selected"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" nothing plays at all. Two sources, one shape:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Source | Lives in | Gets there by |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Built-in | `assets/launch/<id>/` in this package | `node scripts/add-launch-skin.mjs <video> --nam"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"e "..."` (`--poster`, `--duration`, `--name-en` optional) |
| Custom | `<DSH_HOME>/launch-animations"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"/<id>/` | the settings page: pick a file, it uploads to the host and becomes selectable |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The selected id is **host state** (`<DSH_HOME>/launch-animations/state.json`), so every browser of o"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ne install opens on the same curtain — and the host can start the video *before* the module graph is"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" even requested: the served index carries the skin's URLs plus a small inline script that creates th"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"e `<video>`, sets `src` and calls `play()`. The browser half then **adopts that very element** inste"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"ad of restarting it (measured on a 0.2.0-rc.2 host: element at ~100 ms, GUI first paint at ~230 ms, "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"animated curtain ~600 ms)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Selection.** A stored choice wins; with nothing stored (a fresh install, or an id whose skin was r"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"eplaced) the **first built-in skin** plays. Choosing *No skin* stores an explicit null, so the fallb"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ack never overrides a choice. The asset route answers with an `ETag`, so a cached install revalidate"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"s with a 304 instead of re-downloading megabytes."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**What ships today:** two skins, both with a poster frame."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `assets/launch/qinghua` — 青花瓷 · 水墨 (Blue-and-White · Ink), 12.28 s, 2024×1080 HEVC, ~16 MB.
- `ass"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ets/launch/whale-senren` — 鲸鱼娘 · 千恋万花 (Whale Girl · Senren), 12.25 s, 2560×1440 H.264, ~44 MB. Its p"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"oster is frame 0, which is black (the clip fades in from black), so the curtain never opens on the e"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"me 0, which is black (the clip fades in from black), so the curtain never opens on the ending frame."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Together they are most of the package download (see Install) and well past the size budget suggested"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"r they are most of the package download (see Install) and well past the size budget suggested below."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Control | Values | Notes |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Enabled | on / off | Off boots straight to the interface — and skips the early backdrop with it. |"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"
| Launch skin | No skin · every built-in skin · every uploaded one | The video that opens DSH; uplo"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ad and delete custom skins from the same page. |
| Replay | Once per session · Every load | `session"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"` writes a sessionStorage marker. |
| Click to skip | on / off | Escape always lifts the curtain. |
"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"| Preview | button | Plays the selected skin once, right now. |
| Reset | button | Drops the stored "},{"id":"p25s6","text":"playback preferences and returns to the defaults. |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"This plugin is standalone **on purpose**: it is not part of the `@linxin666/dsh-web-all` aggregate, "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"so it never arrives with the family bundle — install it where you want a launch video, and remove it"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"rives with the family bundle — install it where you want a launch video, and remove it the same way."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### 1. Install the package"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The package is **not on npm yet**, so it installs from the repository — which is
exactly what the Wo"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"rkshop's one-click install runs for a registered entry that
carries no `npm` field:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
